prediction.prediction_assessment: INCORRECT (False Negative: AI-generated fantasy artwork predicted as REAL)

faithfulness_test.method: Controlled region occlusion (top sky vs center ring vs exact CAM pixels)

model_behavior_explanation.why_v2_made_this_prediction: The V2 model predicts REAL because its strongest attention is concentrated on the dark starry night sky in the upper quadrant. The ImageNet-1K pretrained convolutional filters (frozen in V2) associate natural astrophotography / night starfields with authentic photography. Because V2's synthetic training dataset (CIFAKE + GenImage) contained exclusively daylight object photographs and zero fantasy or night-sky images, the model relied on the starry background as a shortcut for REAL imagery. When the sky region is occluded, REAL probability drops substantially, proving that the night sky was the deciding factor.
model_behavior_explanation.trustworthiness: HIGHLY INFORMATIVE OF MODEL BEHAVIOR, BUT EVIDENCE IS A DATASET SHORTCUT
model_behavior_explanation.root_cause: Domain Shift & Dataset Bias (V2 trained on ImageNet/CIFAR object diffusion; fantasy cosmic illustrations are entirely unrepresented).

v3_recommendations: Add diverse artistic, fantasy, and cosmic synthetic images to candidate training data
Unfreeze upper feature blocks (features[6-8]) in EfficientNet-B0 to reduce frozen ImageNet semantic bias
Implement letterboxing to prevent 2:1 panoramic aspect ratio squeezing
Implement calibrated confidence reporting with uncertainty flags for out-of-distribution artistic styles
